guidance.headline: SNB held at zero as its conditional inflation forecast stayed in target
guidance.guidance: The SNB maintained a 0% policy rate. Its published inflation forecast assumed a constant policy rate and was within its price-stability range; that assumption is not a promise to hold future rates.
guidance.watch: Swiss inflation, franc exchange-rate developments and global uncertainty

assessment.rationale: The conditional inflation forecast stays within price stability under an unchanged-rate assumption; the bank judges policy appropriate. This supports a research hold baseline, not a promise.
